name: dhh
description: DHH - Indian hip hop catalog. Convenience scripts; frontend/ and backend/ are independent packages.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix backend run db:deploy && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
